text.p: Struggling Apple Computer Inc. on Friday set out a four-point plan to simplify its U.S. sales structure and improve the visibility of Apple products in stores and with resellers.
The company said its objectives were to support resellers that carry mostly Apple products, make sales channels more flexible, focus on specific markets and continue to simplify its product line.

"Our current structure does not reward those in the channel who are strong advocates of Apple products nor does it encourage them to focus on the markets where Apple has a strong franchise and industry-leading solutions," said Robin Abrams, vice president and general manager of Apple Americas.
"We intend to change that with these programmes," he added.
Cupertino, Calif.-based Apple's stock fell 12.5 cents to $25.75 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
